title: HtmlCode
responsibility: Renders the native code element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlCode.attributes
inputs.description: Native code attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlCode.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native code element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlCode
outputs.description: The actual native code element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
